Bottom page is intentionally empty because the board has no bottom population.

notes: IPC-2581 Revision B export completed successfully in a fresh Altium session and passes XML and content-structure checks.
Board-level STEP export succeeds when Export Folded Board is disabled; component and enclosure 3D are outside the current package scope.
Gerber X2 was regenerated directly from the final native PcbDoc, including the X2 board profile and PTH/NPTH drill plots; the legacy GKO profile is retained as a CAM fallback.
The color layer PDF was rendered at 144 DPI and all five pages passed visual and non-grayscale checks; Mid-Layer 1 confirms the full-board GND plane.
The published Rezonit TG150 four-layer 35 um stack is the working package baseline. Exact order values remain deferred corrections.
